clock: single clk; no declared frequency closure
reset: synchronous active-low rst_n; clears partial frames, pipeline and unconsumed outputs
frame: 32 accepted pairs = 64 vector terms; no gaps or stalls count as terms
bias_sampling: first accepted pair only, added exactly once
factor_source: hardware factor32 modules for the same X and W vectors; no software precomputed factors
factor_reuse: R can be reused only across channels of the same input row, C only across rows of the same weight column; recompute after data changes and inside cold task window
protocol: source holds valid and payload until ready; result payload and valid remain stable until accepted; ordered responses; reset discards all outstanding work

dot64_parameters.RESULT_W: derived localparam max(24,BIAS_W+1); not externally overridable

functional_limits: out_dot is signed22 only when supplied R/C belong to the same vectors
BIAS_W=48 returns exact signed49 mathematics, not a legacy per-k signed48 overflow trap
No rounding, output saturation, SRAM layout, array schedule or official bus integration is included
Final pair sum, two factor subtractions and bias addition currently share one combinational correction path; 150MHz unverified
Factor multiplication saves work only when reused across a matrix; isolated scalar dot plus its newly computed factors uses 96 multiplications rather than 64
